news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Initiates Coverage of Perimeter at Buy, PT C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets started coverage of Perimeter Medical Imaging AI (TSXV: PINK; OTCQX: PYNKF) with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a C$0.32 close on July 13. Analyst Kemp Doliver noted Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device status should speed CMS review of the company's pending New Technology APC reimbursement filing, with a decision expected by year-end.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter and Maintains Profound as Healthcare Top Picks
news.summary: Paradigm Capital designated Perimeter a new speculative-buy Top Pick with a C$0.95 target (stock closed C$0.275 on July 3), with analyst Scott McAuley arguing the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire positions Perimeter to accelerate commercial rollout and draw more market interest.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI CEO Presents Commercial Strategy Update at Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented a company update on current commercial strategy and upcoming milestones at the Planet MicroCap Showcase (June 16-18, Bellagio, Las Vegas), aimed at broadening the company's investor base ahead of its Claire commercial ramp.

news.headline: Perimeter Selected for INOVAIT Pilot Fund to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter was selected as one of 10 projects funded in the latest INOVAIT Pilot Fund round, receiving up to roughly $148,000 plus a $100,000 Mitacs award to advance next-generation AI capabilities (improved data labeling, performance characterization, OR-hardware deployment) for its Claire platform.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Closes Final Tranche of Non-Brokered Private Placement
news.summary: Perimeter closed the second and final tranche of its non-brokered private placement of convertible debentures, issuing CDN$3,280,000 in principal and bringing the debenture offering to CDN$6,040,000 in aggregate proceeds, part of a broader capital raise (alongside a May 2026 LIFE offering) to fund working capital during its commercial launch of Claire.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision for Claire
catalysts.detail: Perimeter filed for New Technology Ambulatory Payment Classification status for Claire under the MEARIS quarterly review process; Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device designation is expected to speed the review. With the filing made in the June quarterly cycle, the company is targeting a January 1, 2027 effective date for incremental Medicare outpatient reimbursement (an earlier October 1, 2026 effective date is considered possible but unlikely).

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Perimeter had not formally announced its Q2 2026 results conference call date as of late July 2026; third-party earnings calendars pencil in an early-September 2026 report (prior quarter, Q1 2026, was reported May 28), with investors watching Claire commercial placements and recurring revenue growth post-FDA approval.

catalysts.label: Intermountain Health systemwide rollout
catalysts.detail: Under the systemwide agreement signed in January 2026, deployment of Perimeter's S-Series/Claire OCT technology into additional Intermountain Health operating rooms across the Mountain West is expected to continue through 2026.

catalysts.label: Next-gen B-Series OCT with ImgAssist AI 2.0 pathway
catalysts.detail: Following positive pivotal trial data (breakthrough-device designation, CPRIT-supported) and new INOVAIT/Mitacs-backed AI development funding secured in June 2026, Perimeter's next-generation B-Series platform is expected to progress toward further regulatory/commercial milestones, though no confirmed FDA decision date has been disclosed.

catalysts.label: Potential U.S. redomiciliation and Nasdaq uplisting
catalysts.detail: Sell-side commentary has pointed to an embedded option in Perimeter's 2026 financing structure that could support a move of corporate domicile from British Columbia to the U.S. and a delisting from TSXV in favor of a Nasdaq listing; this has not been confirmed as a formal company plan or given a target date.

pulse: Since winning FDA PMA approval for its Claire OCT system in March 2026 - the first AI-enabled imaging device cleared for intraoperative breast cancer margin assessment - Perimeter has been building sell-side coverage and investor visibility, picking up two new buy-rated initiations in July 2026 (Paradigm Capital PT C$0.95, Brookline Capital Markets PT C$1.54) while the shares have traded well below those targets in the C$0.20s-0.30s amid dilution from its May/June 2026 LIFE offering and convertible-debenture financings. No major company-specific news has broken since the mid-July analyst initiations; the company continues expanding hospital adoption under its Intermountain Health systemwide agreement and secured non-dilutive INOVAIT/Mitacs funding in June to advance next-gen AI capabilities. Near-term focus is on the pending CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision for Claire (targeting a January 1, 2027 effective date) and on Q2 2026 results, expected around early September 2026 but not yet formally scheduled, as the market watches whether Claire's FDA clearance translates into accelerating recurring revenue.
